rawResults.Title: What's new in the Azure Backup service - Azure Backup | Microsoft Learn
rawResults.Snippet: Azure Backup now supports snapshot-based backups for SQL Server instances in Azure virtual machines (preview). This capability combines fast, disk-based snapshots with frequent log backups to deliver faster restores (improved Recovery Time Objective) and minimal data loss (low Recovery Point Objective) for large SQL databases.
